rows.quote: Data on stroke patients were obtained from one of the largest genome-wide meta-analyses conducted by the MEGASTROKE Consortium (Table 1) [20].
rows.reference_quote: Malik R Chauhan G Traylor M Sargurupremraj M Okada Y Mishra A Rutten-Jacobs L Giese AK Multiancestry genome-wide association study of 520,000 subjects identifies 32 loci associated with stroke and stroke subtypes Nat Genet 2018 50 4 524 537 10.1038/s41588-018-0058-3 29531354 PMC5968830
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the stroke data to the MEGASTROKE meta-analysis [20]; entry 20's DOI 10.1038/s41588-018-0058-3 is the source of exactly one dictionary row; the Table 1 subtype counts with 100% European are subtype and ancestry-subset counts, not a release-defining N of another row (rule H).
Table 1 gives 'UK Biobank dataset' with case and control counts (3314/357,880) and no release, pipeline, accession or citation; counts with a cohort name alone do not identify a release (rule I1).

Table 1 lists 'IMPROVE,INTERVAL,KORA F4' with a pooled 9775 and no citation; the grouped citation [17-19] in the text is not mapped to INTERVAL by order or wording (rule F), and a cohort name alone identifies no release (rule D).
